video_caption: The video opens on a football field where a player in a white and blue Barcelona jersey, wearing number 8, dribbles a yellow and black football past an opponent in a red and white striped jersey with the number 30. The scene then transitions to an inverted color filter, highlighting player 8 as he kicks the ball, followed by a black and white shot of a player in a white jersey on his knees, head bowed, seemingly in distress, with other players or staff members attending to him. Next, a man in a light blue Napoli jersey is seen speaking into a microphone in a studio setting, with "THE GAB & JULS SHOW" logo visible behind him. The footage cuts back to the Barcelona player in the white jersey, now covering his face with gloved hands, then looking up with a pained expression, suggesting emotional distress. The studio host is shown again, continuing to speak, before the scene returns to the football field, where the white-jerseyed player is lying on the ground, being helped by another player in blue shorts. A purple and blue filter is applied to this injury scene, and the word "CURSED" appears in stylized red and blue text over the image. Three retro television screens are then displayed, each showing a news headline that reads: "FC Barcelona Considers Selling Pedri This Summer, Reports AS." The video then shifts to a vibrant scene of a young Pedri, in a Barcelona home jersey with "Rakuten" sponsor, holding a football and smiling brightly in front of a yellow "BEN VINGUT PEDRI" (WELCOME PEDRI) banner. This is followed by Pedri, in the same home jersey, passionately kissing the Barcelona crest on his shirt during what appears to be a celebration. The segment concludes with a man with dark hair, wearing a blue and white striped shirt, speaking into a microphone directly to the camera, with a football jersey, books, and a television displaying a football match in the background.

The video begins with a young man wearing a white and blue striped jersey speaking into a black microphone, with soccer scarves hanging on a wall behind him and a TV showing a soccer player on the right. The scene then transitions to a black screen displaying white text: "[THE START OF THIS MESS]", followed by "AUGUST 2020". This is replaced by a bright yellow and red background featuring a large graphic of a smiling male soccer player. A man in a suit jacket and face mask stands next to the graphic, holding a pen as if signing it. The view zooms out, revealing more of the background, including a large red "SPORT" logo and the name "PEDRI" overlapping the image, along with other newspaper clippings.

A young man with brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped jersey, looks directly at the camera and speaks with his mouth open, gesturing slightly with his head. Behind him, a door is visible on the left, adorned with several hanging scarves, one of which clearly reads "IRELAND". To his right, a television screen displays a soccer player in a blue and red jersey, possibly Pedri, further suggesting the video's topic.

The video segment opens with a soccer player, wearing a blue and red striped jersey with blue shorts and red cleats, bent over with hands on his knees on a green field, looking distraught. This transitions to the same player in a yellow and blue striped jersey performing leg presses in a gym with white tiled walls, focusing on his exercise. He then appears again, lying on his back on the green field, holding his bent knees with a pained expression. Subsequently, he is shown standing on the field, pulling his blue and red striped jersey over his face, with the text "41 MATCHES OUT" (meaning he missed 41 games) displayed in white, highlighting the severity of his injury. The scene changes to the player in a dark blue, red, and light blue striped jersey with a "Spotify" sponsor logo, standing on the field with the text "2022-2023" indicating the season, followed by him sitting on the field, grimacing but also smiling slightly, as the text "15 MATCHES OUT" (meaning he missed 15 games) appears. A male presenter with brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped shirt, then speaks directly to the camera from a room with soccer scarves hanging on a door and a monitor showing a soccer player in the background. The video briefly shows a close-up of two people's legs, one wearing blue and black sneakers and the other dark shoes, walking up stone steps, illustrating the compensation in movement due to injury, before returning to the presenter speaking to the camera.

The video opens with a close-up of a young man, a football player, wearing a blue and red striped jersey with a white Nike swoosh and the Spotify logo, looking intense. He then performs a "binoculars" gesture by putting his hands around his eyes and looking upwards, before the scene transitions to a wider shot of a football match where he, wearing jersey number 8, is dribbling the ball past an opposing player in a cream-colored jersey, with "Lay's" logos visible on the advertising boards in the background. Following this, two still images appear; the first shows the player in his match kit looking thoughtful, and the second captures him in a grey long-sleeved training top and black trousers, powerfully striking a football with his right foot on a green practice field. Another still image features him in a white sleeveless training top, black shorts, and a Spotify armband, concentrating while dribbling the ball on the grass. The video then cuts to a man with long brown hair wearing a white and blue striped football jersey, speaking directly to the camera into a microphone. Behind him, various football scarves are hung on a door, and a television screen displays a football match. The final shot is a still image of the football player from the beginning, smiling broadly and clapping his hands, dressed in a sleeveless training top.

The video opens with a young man with long brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped jersey, speaking into a black microphone. Behind him, on the left, hangs a rack of multiple scarves, and on the right, a TV displays a close-up of a soccer player. The scene transitions to a blurred photo of a large group of soccer players in blue and red striped jerseys, where three players in the front row are distinctly in focus, smiling. The video then shows an image of a soccer player (Ilkay Gundogan) in a blue and red striped Barcelona jersey with the number 2 and a "Spotify" logo, celebrating with outstretched arms. This quickly changes to the same player in a light blue Manchester City jersey, also celebrating, followed by a younger version of him in a maroon and white jersey, with the text "24 different injuries" superimposed above him, indicating the number of injuries he sustained. The speaker reappears, then the video cuts to a photo of the soccer player lying on the ground in a yellow Borussia Dortmund jersey, attended by other players and staff, with the text "428 Days Out" displayed, signifying the duration of his absence. Another image shows the player in his yellow Dortmund jersey smiling and shaking hands with a man in a black jacket and yellow cap. Subsequently, a photo depicts the player on the ground in his light blue Manchester City jersey, clutching his leg in pain during a match. The scene transitions to a photo of the player walking on crutches with a leg brace, accompanied by two other people. Finally, the video returns to the young man speaking into the microphone, and a red and blue button appears in the lower-left corner with the text "JBSCRIBE," encouraging viewers to subscribe.

The video begins with a crumpled paper-like border framing a soccer player in a light blue and red striped jersey with a "Spotify" logo and number "22", attempting to kick a yellow ball on a green field, with another player in a similar jersey and one in yellow and blue also visible against a backdrop of yellow-clad spectators. This transitions to a player in a light blue jersey with "ETIHAD AIRWAYS", celebrating with outstretched arms on a soccer field at night, followed by a split screen showing this same celebrating player on the left and a young man in a dark blue and red striped "Spotify" jersey on the right, running on a field with "1XBET" visible on advertising boards. The next three scenes offer aerial views of different soccer matches during the day, showing players in yellow, blue and white, or light blue and dark blue jerseys, passing a yellow ball on a green field, with a referee in light blue or black also present, and advertising boards displaying "1XBET". The video then shows a bearded player in a blue and red striped jersey with an FC Barcelona crest and a "Rolling Stones" tongue logo, celebrating jubilantly with arms wide and eyes closed, embracing another player in a similar jersey. Finally, the segment concludes with a medium shot of a young man with long dark brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped athletic shirt, speaking into a black microphone in a room adorned with a wall hanging displaying "IRELAND" and folded soccer jerseys, and a monitor behind him showing a soccer player, illuminated by red and blue ambient lights.

The video opens with a black crumpled paper texture, over which text appears: "TWO PLAYERS". This transitions to a split screen with two images on the crumpled background, one of Kylian Mbappé in a PSG jersey and another of Pedri in a Barcelona jersey. More text overlays: "ONE PEDRI" and "ONE MBAPPE". The scene changes to Mbappé walking confidently on a football pitch, holding a golden award, dressed in a dark blue and white tracksuit with "QATAR AIRWAYS" and "PARIS" branding, with stadium lights and smoke in the background. Following this, Pedri, in a dark suit and bow tie, is seen shaking hands with a bald man in a dark suit, both smiling, with a golden award between them, indicating an award ceremony. The video then shows several action shots: Mbappé dribbling and scoring a goal in a dark blue PSG jersey against a defender in white, then in a white PSG jersey. Concurrently, Pedri is shown in a yellow Barcelona jersey (number 16) dribbling, then in a blue and red Barcelona jersey dribbling past players in white, and also falling to the ground in a tackle. Another image appears on the crumpled background: a man in black shorts holding his right thigh, which is highlighted red, overlaid with the text "QUADRICEP INJURY". Mbappé's face is shown in a close-up, followed by more action shots of him dribbling effectively against defenders, wearing both white and dark blue PSG jerseys. Pedri is then seen running and passing the ball in a black and tan jersey, and another scene shows him dribbling with a blue and red jersey. The video cuts to a young man with long brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped jersey, speaking into a microphone in a room with football scarves on the wall and a TV showing a football player. This man continues to speak as the video shows Pedri distressed on a football pitch, covering his face, then being attended to by medical staff while sitting on the ground. A still image of Pedri in training gear (black shorts, grey top with Spotify logo) performing a lunge exercise with resistance bands is presented on the crumpled background. Finally, action shots of Pedri on the pitch in a Barcelona jersey are shown, including him looking at the ball with a player sitting nearby, and running with the ball before kicking it, with "BURGER KING" visible as a sponsor. The video concludes with the speaker talking.

The video opens with a young man, sporting medium-length dark hair and wearing a white and blue striped jersey, speaking directly into a microphone. His mouth is open as if in mid-sentence, suggesting he is presenting or commentating. Behind him to the left, a dark fabric organizer hangs, displaying several football scarves, one prominently featuring the text "IRELAND" (English). To his right, a television screen displays a football match featuring a player in a blue and red jersey. The scene then transitions to a high-angle view of a football pitch where two players are near the center line. One player, wearing a blue and red striped kit, dribbles the ball forward while being closely marked by an opponent in a white and black jersey. The next shot shows a wider view of a football match from a slightly lower angle. Several players are visible on the bright green pitch. A player in a yellow and blue striped jersey is in possession of the ball, surrounded by opposing players in blue and white striped jerseys, and a referee in a pink uniform. In the background, advertising hoardings display various brand names including "ZOTAPAY" (English), "INNOO" (English), "KELME" (English), and "AGRICULTURAL TIRE" (English).

The video segment opens with a wide shot of a football match on a bright green field, with players in yellow and blue and white jerseys moving across the pitch. The camera pans to follow the ball, which is being dribbled by a player in a yellow jersey, while other players from both teams are in pursuit. The scene quickly transitions to a close-up of a dark-haired man with a beard and mustache, wearing a blue and red striped FC Barcelona jersey with the number "22" and the "Spotify" logo, looking directly ahead with a focused expression as a blurred teammate in a yellow jersey stands behind him. This image then changes to a headshot of a smiling young man with dark hair, wearing a red, blue, and yellow long-sleeved FC Barcelona training top, also featuring the "Spotify" logo, against a dark, textured background.

The video opens with a young man, wearing a white and blue striped short-sleeved t-shirt, speaking directly to the camera. He has brown hair and is positioned in what appears to be a room with dark walls, red and blue ambient lighting, a door on the left with scarves or jerseys hanging vertically, and a computer monitor displaying a football player in the background on the right. As he speaks about risk and Ansu Fati, the scene cuts to a football match where a player in a blue and red striped jersey (Ansu Fati) is dribbling the ball on a green field and is tackled by two players in green and white striped jerseys, falling to the ground. A close-up shot follows, showing Ansu Fati on the ground, grimacing in pain and clutching his knee, wearing a blue and red striped jersey with "RAKUTEN" printed on it and "BARCA" on his shorts. The video then transitions to a series of grainy, vintage-filtered football clips framed with orange borders, showing Ansu Fati in a yellow jersey, running, celebrating, and scoring, with crowds in the stadium background. One clip shows a player with "RAPINHA 22" on the back of his white jersey, while Ansu Fati is in a blue and red striped jersey. The style then shifts back to clear, modern footage of Ansu Fati on the field, now wearing a blue and red striped jersey with "Spotify" and "10" visible, looking serious, then dribbling the ball. In a subsequent shot, he is seen interacting with a coach (Xavi), who is pointing his finger, seemingly giving instructions. The video briefly returns to the vintage-filtered style, showing Ansu Fati in a yellow jersey with "ANSU FATI 10" on the back, running, followed by a clip of him kicking the ball in a different match, before finally returning to the young man speaking to the camera, emphasizing his points with hand gestures.

A young man with medium-length brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped shirt, speaks directly into a black microphone with a pop filter. To his left, a wall hanging displays the word "IRELAND" vertically, above several folded football jerseys. To his right, a television screen shows a football player in a blue and red jersey. The room is dimly lit, with hints of red and blue ambient light in the background.

The video segment features a young man with longish brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt with blue stripes on the collar and sleeves, speaking directly to the camera from 0:02-0:07, and then again from 0:25-0:32. He is seated in front of a microphone, and in the background, a hanging organizer displays several stacked scarves, one prominently featuring the text "IRELAND" in white letters against a dark background. To his right, a monitor shows a soccer player in a red and blue jersey, and the room has ambient red-pink lighting. Between 0:07 and 0:25, the video transitions through several clips featuring a young male soccer player identified as Fermin Lopez, wearing various FC Barcelona kits. At 0:07, he is shown from the chest up in a red and blue striped jersey with "Spotify" and the club crest, running with a focused expression against a black background. This transitions to him jogging on a green field in a white and black training shirt with the "Spotify" and club crest, accompanied by another man in a black training shirt, against a blue background with white Nike swoosh logos from 0:09-0:13. Next, from 0:13-0:16, he appears in a white FC Barcelona jersey with "Spotify" and the club crest, with his hands clasped in front of him, looking up with a subtle smile in a stadium setting. The scene then shifts to an action shot during a soccer match from 0:16-0:18, where Fermin Lopez in a red and blue striped jersey is shown alongside another Barcelona player, defending against an opponent in a white jersey (likely Vinicius Jr. of Real Madrid) on a green pitch. Finally, from 0:18-0:25, Fermin Lopez is seen celebrating a goal in his red and blue striped FC Barcelona jersey, first pulling at his shirt with an ecstatic expression, and then with arms outstretched, yelling in jubilation, all framed by a yellow border with a blurred stadium crowd in the background.

The video montage opens with four digital images of young male soccer player Pedri, three in yellow FC Barcelona jerseys with the Spotify logo, one in a red jersey, and one in a blue and red striped jersey, all showing him smiling or making expressive faces. This transitions to a live-action shot of Pedri, wearing a black FC Barcelona jersey with "PEDRI 16 unicef" on the back, on a soccer field sideline with former coach Ronald Koeman, who is pointing and talking to him, while other masked staff are seated behind. The next scene shows Pedri in a blue and red striped FC Barcelona kit, holding a small soccer ball, standing in front of a yellow banner that reads "BEN ENGUT PEDRI" (likely a play on "Bienvenido," meaning "Welcome") and displays the FC Barcelona logo and a jersey. The video then cuts back to Koeman talking to Pedri (again wearing "PEDRI 16") and another player, Trincao ("TRINÇAO 17"), both in blue and red striped FC Barcelona jerseys on a lit soccer field at night. A dramatic, fiery red and orange background then appears behind a close-up of Pedri's face, with dark smudges around his eyes, and text overlays "73 MATCHES" to the right. The scene shifts to a male presenter with brown hair, wearing a white and blue striped shirt, speaking into a microphone in a room with scarves hanging on a door and a TV screen showing a soccer player. He gestures with his hands as he speaks. The video then displays Pedri in a yellow FC Barcelona jersey, looking expressive on the field, followed by a split-screen showing multiple scenes of Pedri injured on the field: lying on the grass holding his chest, and crouching in pain holding his leg, interspersed with a shot of his teammates comforting another player. The video concludes with the male presenter speaking into the microphone again, gesturing and emphasizing his points.
